biggest_catch: The $4,000 is a full-year ceiling requiring up to twice-weekly donations for a year — and you must pass medical screening (not everyone qualifies), with compensation varying by location.
catches: The 'as much as $4,000 per year' figure is an annual ceiling requiring sustained donations (up to twice a week, with at least 24 hours between) for a full year — roughly 100+ visits.
You must pass a medical history screening and physical exam before donating; not everyone qualifies, and first-time donors must return for a second donation to receive compensation.
Each donation visit takes significant time: ABO's own pages say the full process takes 1-2 hours for first-time donors (90-150 minutes per visit range), with repeat visits shorter.
Exact amounts vary by location and ongoing promotions; the headline figure is not a guaranteed total.
Per-donation amounts stated on ABO's own informational pages range from $30 to $100, so the per-visit pay is modest relative to the time.

steps: Fill out the appointment form on ABO Plasma's official site and schedule your first visit (appointments required for first-time donors).
Attend your first visit: complete the medical history screening and physical exam to be approved as a donor.
Donate plasma up to twice a week (at least 24 hours between donations); first-time donors must return for a second donation to receive compensation.
Receive compensation for each donation within 24 hours of extraction.
